items.title: Riddles
items.description: Brain-teasing riddles for the whole class. Read it out, let them think, then reveal the answer.

items.title: Word scramble
items.description: Unscramble the letters before the timer runs out. Hints available if they get stuck.

items.title: Would you rather…
items.description: Two choices, one decision. Hands up for A or B, then ask a few pupils to explain why.

items.title: Odd one out
items.description: Four things, one doesn’t belong. Can they spot it — and explain why?

items.title: Emoji puzzles
items.description: Work out the common saying or phrase hidden in a line of emojis.

items.title: Quick-fire quiz
items.description: General knowledge questions with a built-in team scoreboard. Perfect for the end of term.
